{{Top|leg}}
The [[Calin Industries]] '''medium plating type 2''' signaled a shift in industrial production from construction [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to [[Battle droid/Legends|military]] models. It began seeing use on many different [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
